replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: Math is not my favorite subject. I prefer physics and biology, which come more naturally to me. Math feels abstract and less engaging, so I tend to focus on subjects that align with my interests.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Not really. Since I'm not too invested in math, it doesn't cause me much stress. I focus on my strengths in other subjects, so math doesn't bother me much.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: No, I haven’t used AI for math. I rely on textbooks and teachers. I’m not very open to new tools, preferring traditional methods that work for me.
